builtBy: Research by hand, 2026-11-13, for the girls volleyball build (the 41 SCVAL and BVAL schools): the club records from each club's own website; the ties from the players' Hudl, NCSA, SportsRecruits and MaxPreps career pages, the clubs' own rosters, Prep Dig's player pages, school and local papers and one college's signing release. Every Hudl and NCSA page was re-read by an independent refuter; no script rebuilds this file.
notes: The youth volleyball clubs players on the 41 tracked varsity rosters are tied to, and the other girls' clubs found in and around Santa Clara County. The linking rule is field hockey's (README, "Clubs"), with one change of place: a public page must name the player and a volleyball or beach volleyball club, and either name the player's high school, or give a class year equal to the roster's along with a hometown in the school's own area. A name alone never counts, a class year that disagrees with the roster rules a match out, and social media is never a source.

Club records: the candidate list was the NCVA 2025-26 Girls Power League points tables for 15s to 18s (84 club codes; ncva.com has no public club directory), then every club a player's own page names. Each record was written from the club's own site. South Bay and Peninsula clubs were looked for; the East Bay, Central Coast, San Francisco and Marin records are clubs a player is tied to or that were met on the way, and those areas were not searched for every club. The Edge Volleyball Club is an Illinois club one Fremont player's Hudl page lists (region elsewhere).

No record, so no tie shown, although a player's page names the club: Apex Volleyball Club (two Pioneer players' NCSA pages, three SportsRecruits pages and one Prep Dig page; it plays NCVA events, but no site or city was found), Absolute Volleyball Club (Los Gatos' Britt Melinauskas, on Hudl, SportsRecruits and PrepVolleyball; its site answered with a bot challenge), J5 Beach Volleyball and Golden Gate Beach Volleyball (one player each), BRX, Club 415 and Bay Area Eagles (one MaxPreps career page each), and three Hudl organizations that may not be clubs (Titans Athletics, Global Challenge). About 20 NCVA Power League clubs have no record because their websites were not found without a web search (the session's search allowance ran out): among them SPVC, VVA, FPVC, ITVC, Spark, Samba, Amplify, Cloud, Lakas, Vibe, Kamikaze, Endline, Xceleration, Paye's Place, Elite (Burlingame) and Celsius (San Jose).

Status. current: a source from the 2025-26 or 2026-27 club season (the club's own 2026-27 roster, a Hudl or NCSA entry for 2026 or later, a page dated 2026, a MaxPreps career entry joined or edited in 2026). past: a Hudl or NCSA entry that ends in 2024 or earlier, or a source that says she left. unknown: everything else, such as a Hudl entry for 2025 (which may be the 2024-25 or the 2025-26 club season) or an undated club list. A Hudl year range is partly a team's lifespan on Hudl, so a past tie's year is approximate.

Hudl ties: the team list of each linked Hudl profile, which is on the school's own volleyball team and so names the school. One tie per club, quoting the latest entry's team name, organization, sport and years (data fields of the page, joined with ' / '). Left out: coaches' accounts, entries that end before the player's sixth grade, and organizations that are schools. Each list was read twice, by the sweep and by the refuter, and only entries in both reads are used.

Club rosters give names only (Mountain View Volleyball Club's 2026-27 LeagueApps rosters, Vision's 2025-26 teams page, Academy's SportsRecruits list, Legend's team pages), so a roster match is a tie only where a second page names the player with the same club and her school: 45 ties were completed that way and about 60 exact-name matches were left out. The Mountain View rosters are read at the cited address with '&ngmp_2023_iframe_transition=1' added, which is what the page's own frame loads.
JV players' club ties are not listed: the volleyball JV lists are not rows of the varsity file, so jvAffiliations is empty.
